# RWAToday.news
> Independent editorial coverage of real-world asset (RWA) tokenization

RWAToday.news covers the tokenization of real-world assets — tokenized securities, private credit, real estate, commodities, infrastructure, and the blockchain protocols that enable them.

## Key Pages
- [Article Index](https://rwatoday.news/articles) — Full index of all published articles
- [Search](https://rwatoday.news/search) — Search across all 160+ articles
- [Newsletter](https://rwatoday.beehiiv.com/subscribe) — Weekly RWA This Week digest

## Coverage Areas
- Tokenized securities (equities, bonds, Treasuries)
- Private credit and tokenized lending
- Real estate tokenization
- Commodity tokenization (gold, carbon credits, energy)
- RWA regulation: US (SEC, DTCC, CLARITY Act), EU (MiCA, ECB), Asia-Pacific (MAS, FSC, FSA)
- Institutional adoption: BlackRock BUIDL, Securitize, Ondo, Franklin Templeton, DTCC
- Blockchain infrastructure for RWA: Ethereum, Avalanche, Stellar, XRP Ledger
